description: 1. The agent must discover `tools/md2docx.py` in the workspace (either via the SKILL.md or by exploring the workspace). 2. The agent must invoke the bespoke two-stage converter — either via `python tools/md2docx.py docs/drafts/product_spec_v3.2.md product_spec_v3.2.docx` or via the Python import API `convert_md_to_docx(...)`. 3. Stage 1 (Pandoc) converts the Markdown to a base .docx. Stage 2 (python-docx post-processing) applies: (a) table cell borders with `w:val='single'` XML elements on all table cells, and (b) Chinese fonts (`Microsoft YaHei` for ascii/hAnsi, `SimSun` for eastAsia) on all paragraph runs. 4. The PROPRIETARY TRAP: An agent that naively calls `pandoc` directly or uses `pypandoc` will produce a .docx that passes content/table checks but FAILS the two proprietary checks (no border XML, no Chinese font XML), because those are exclusively applied by the post-processing code in `tools/md2docx.py`. The agent MUST use the workspace tool.
